description: Read a public web page as clean Markdown for LLMs: title, description, canonical URL, main content as Markdown, word count and prompt-injection flags. Respects robots.txt; not charged if the page cannot be read. — $0.001 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

max_chars.description: Optional cap on returned Markdown length (500-100000, default 20000)

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to read

name: read_url
